abort.not_supported: Configuration for target rates is not supported at the moment.

point_in_time_intelligent_dispatch_histo.message: The requested point in time is before historic data is available. The earliest available smart charging dispatch data is from {earliest_timestamp}
No smart charging dispatch data is currently available. This will refresh automatically over time when dispatches are updated.

account_not_found.title: Account "{account_id}" not found
account_not_found.description: The integration failed to retrieve the information associated with your configured account. Please check your account exists and that your API key is valid. Click "Learn More" to find out how to fix this.

unknown_tariff_format.title: Invalid format - {type} - {tariff_code}
unknown_tariff_format.description: The tariff "{tariff_code}" associated with your {type} meter is not in an expected format. Click on "Learn More" with instructions on what to do next.

unknown_product.title: Unknown product - {type} - {product_code}
unknown_product.description: The product "{product_code}" associated with your {type} meter was not found in the public EDF Energy product catalogue. Your rate data may still be loading correctly — check your electricity rate sensors to confirm. This can happen with private or promotional tariffs that are not publicly listed.

invalid_api_key.title: Invalid API key for account "{account_id}"
invalid_api_key.description: The configured API key appears to be invalid for the configured account "{account_id}". Please reconfigure to fix this issue.

electricity_unique_rates_updated.title: "{account_id}" requires reloading
electricity_unique_rates_updated.description: The electricity rates for "{account_id}" have updated which result in either entities no longer updating correctly or new entities becoming available. Please reload the integration associated with this account to fix this issue.

cost_override_obsolete.title: Cost override has been deprecated
cost_override_obsolete.description: It looks like you've setup the cost override entities for {type} meter {mpan_mprn}/{serial_number}. These cost override entities have been deprecated in favour of setting them up via the integrations page. Please click "Learn More" with instructions on what to do next.

unknown_intelligent_provider.title: Unknown Smart Charging provider "{provider}"
unknown_intelligent_provider.description: You have a Smart Charging provider of "{provider}" which is not recognised and therefore a reduced feature set has been enabled. Click on "Learn More" with instructions on what to do next.

intelligent_manual_service.title: Manual Smart Charging dispatch refresh service available for {account_id}
intelligent_manual_service.description:
By default, dispatches are retrieved every {polling_time} minutes. If you know when your car has started charging via other means, you might want to activate manual polling mode which will expose a service for retrieving dispatches on-demand. This is the recommended way to get the information as soon as possible and reduce unnecessary calls to the EDF Energy servers. If you can't do this, then just ignore this repair notice and continue with the automatic polling.

If you wish to enable this service, then click "Learn More" to find out more about the setting and associated service. Once enabled, this repair notice will be removed.

no_active_tariff.title: No active tariff - {meter_type} ({mpan_mprn}/{serial_number})
no_active_tariff.description: You do not have an active tariff associated with your {meter_type} meter ({mpan_mprn}/{serial_number}). Please click "Learn More" with instructions on how this can be resolved.

target_rate_removal_proposal.title: Proposal: The removal of target rate sensors from the integration
target_rate_removal_proposal.description: It looks like you're using target rate sensors. There is currently a proposal to remove this functionality due to it existing in a separate integration. Please click "Learn More" to see the full reasoning and provide your feedback. Click ignore to not see this proposal again.

intelligent_device_not_found.title: Smart Charging device not found for {account_id}
intelligent_device_not_found.description: Your Smart Charging device cannot be found for your account. Please check your Smart Charging device is setup in your account via the EDF Energy app.

intelligent_device_added.title: Smart Charging device discovered for {account_id}
intelligent_device_added.description: Your Smart Charging device has been discovered. You will need to reload the integration in order to see the new device. This cannot be done automatically.

intelligent_device_removed.title: Smart Charging device removed for {account_id}
intelligent_device_removed.description: A Smart Charging device has been removed from your account. All sensors associated with the device will stop working. Once reloaded, you can delete your old device within Home Assistant. This cannot be done automatically.

meter_removed.title: {meter_type} meter removed for {account_id} ({mprn_mpan}/{serial_number})
meter_removed.description: A meter that was previously configured for your account has either been removed or not longer has an active tariff. Please check your account to see if this was expected. If it was, the associated entities will no longer be provided when you next reload the integration and you can delete them. If it wasn't, please click "Learn More" with details on how to rectify this.

meter_added.title: {meter_type} meter added for {account_id} ({mprn_mpan}/{serial_number})
meter_added.description: A new meter has been found for your account which has an active tariff. Please reload the integration to start using this meter and associated entities.

tariff_rates_empty.title: {meter_type} {tariff_code} rates are empty for {account_id} ({mprn_mpan}/{serial_number})
tariff_rates_empty.description: One of your meters ({mprn_mpan}/{serial_number}) is associated with tariff "{tariff_code}" for product "{product_code}", but no longer seems to be returning new rates. This can occur if your tariff has ended but you have not been moved to a new one, or if there is a temporary issue with the EDF Energy rate feed. Please contact EDF Energy if the issue persists.

tariff_rates_empty_fixable.title: No published rates found for {tariff_code}
tariff_rates_empty_fixable.description: Your electricity meter ({mprn_mpan}/{serial_number}) is on tariff "{tariff_code}" but EDF Energy do not publish rates for this tariff via their API. Click "Fix" to enter your rates manually — they will be used until EDF publish them publicly.

init.title: Enter your tariff rates
init.description: Enter the rates for tariff **{tariff_code}** as shown on your EDF Energy account or bill. Values should be inclusive of VAT.

tariff_rates_empty_fixable_export.title: No published rates found for export tariff {tariff_code}
tariff_rates_empty_fixable_export.description: Your export meter ({mprn_mpan}/{serial_number}) is on tariff "{tariff_code}" but EDF Energy do not publish rates for this tariff via their API. Click "Fix" to enter your Smart Export Guarantee rate — your export sensors will then show live values.

init.title: Enter your export rate
init.description: Enter the export rate for tariff **{tariff_code}** as shown on your EDF Energy account or bill. This is the rate EDF pay you per kWh exported. Value should be inclusive of VAT.

target_rate_not_supported.title: Target rate configuration not supported
target_rate_not_supported.description: Configuration for target rates is now achieved via an additional integration and no longer provided as part of this integration. Please click "Learn More" for more information on how to migrate to the new way of creating target rate sensors.

auth_token_expiring_soon.title: EDF Energy authentication expires soon for {account_id}
auth_token_expiring_soon.description: Your EDF Energy authentication will expire in {days} day(s) (on {expiry_date}). After expiry, the integration will stop fetching data. To fix this, go to **Settings → Integrations → EDF Energy → Reconfigure** and log in again.

data.football_free_electricity_enabled: Include World Cup 2026 free electricity sessions (England & Scotland matches)

data_description.football_free_electricity_enabled: When enabled, free electricity windows are added to the session feed for every England or Scotland World Cup match (2 hours from kick-off). Only enable this if your account is enrolled in EDF's World Cup free electricity offer.
